title: KrupicovaKase's Map Utils
description: Collection of utilities to help map makers
body:
This mod includes some utilities for map makers.

# Features

*   Ice Concrete (Concrete with higher slipperiness)
*   Resourcepack compatibility (concrete uses vannila textures)
*   Bunch of useful commands (see below)

# Commands

*   `/maputils lightning_bolt_effect coordinates <x> <y> <z>` - Strikes an effect-only lightning bolt at given coordinates
*   `/maputils lightning_bolt_effect entity <entity>` - Strikes an effect-only lightning bolt at given entity's coordinates
*   `/maputils bypass <command>` - Runs provided command with permission level specified in the config. Disabled by default

# Config

- Disable or enable any of the commands above.
- Specify permission level used by the bypass command (4 by default)
